text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Yushun Himba (Oaks). Since 
it was a race with deep ties to her 
mother, Daiichi Ruby faced even greater 
expectations than at the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still unable to find an effective strategy 
for middle distance... Even so, Daiichi 
Ruby proudly declares at the press 
conference that she will avenge her 
mother's defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer encourages her to believe not 
only in her talent, but also in the hard 
work she has accumulated. The race for her 
family's long-cherished crown begins—!
